items.title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
items.description: The US says attacks on Iran have been halted to give "talks some space", raising hopes of a resolution to the conflict.

items.title: Anger, shock and grief - questions remain in the wake of the Berlin Pride attack
items.description: As details emerge about the suspected Berlin Pride attacker's past, many are asking why he was not in prison.

items.title: Three dead and several injured in shooting at food festival near Seattle's Space Needle
items.description: Police say two suspects were shooting at each other and one of them is in custody and one at large.

items.title: Pirlo out of Italy football top job after backlash over Russian betting firm links
items.description: The uproar throws the Italian Football Federation into further disarray following Italy's third consecutive failure to qualify for the World Cup.

items.title: Bali bans Dutch expats whose run club allegedly excluded Indonesians
items.description: The two men, who are accused of favouring foreigners for their events, allegedly violated immigration laws.

items.title: Millions see leaked copy of The Odyssey movie on X
items.description: Film studio Universal takes down a high-quality bootleg version of the film, which appeared on X.

items.title: Netanyahu accuses NYC Mayor Mamdani of 'fomenting hate' after arrest threat
items.description: Mamdani walked back his threat last week, acknowledging he lacked the legal power to arrest Netanyahu on a warrant issued by the International Criminal Court.
